author: Madrod
quote: Completely outdated and massively overrated. The gameplay feels clunky, the controls have aged poorly, and the pacing is way too slow by modern standards. It survives purely on nostalgia, while in practice it feels repetitive and tedious. A total disappointment.
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time

author: Madrod
quote: An extraordinary generational leap for open-world gaming. Vice City and the state of Leonida deliver an unprecedented level of life, detail, and immersion, backed by refined mechanics and incredible chemistry between Lucia and Jason. Its sheer freedom, sharp satire, and technical scale redefine the industry standard. An absolute masterpiece.
